text: 昔涟余额挂件是面向 DSH 网页与桌面聊天界面的互动角色和模型用量面板。它通过插件注入在聊天页显示角色挂件，并由本地路由提供余额、语音、字体和动画资源。用户可查看 DeepSeek 及其他模型的余额或额度、按余额变化记录消费、查看每日和分模型统计并校正账本；还可播放开屏动画与问候语音，切换角色、音效和台词。适合希望在聊天时查看 API 账户用量并定制陪伴式界面的 DSH 用户。DeepSeek 余额等功能需在 DSH 中配置对应服务商凭据。

Cyrene Balance Widget adds a character and usage panel to DSH chat. It shows provider balances and quotas, tracks daily spend from balance changes, and supports ledger corrections. The widget also offers an opening animation, greeting audio, and controls for characters and sounds.
想在 DSH 聊天页旁边随时查看模型账户还剩多少余额。
希望按天统计 API 消费，并能对余额变化做人工校正。
有没有办法在一个面板里看多个模型服务商的余额或订阅额度？
我想在 DSH 启动时显示一段自定义风格的角色开场动画。
想让聊天界面的角色在打开时播放问候语音，并可选不同问候。
希望给 DSH 的聊天界面加个可换角色、音效和台词的互动挂件。
I want to see my model provider balances and daily API spend inside DSH chat.
Can I add a character widget with greeting audio to the DSH chat screen?
昔涟余额挂件的功能「模型余额与额度」：查询 DeepSeek 等服务商的余额、模型状态或订阅额度，并在面板显示结果。
昔涟余额挂件的功能「消费账本」：根据连续余额观测汇总每日消费，保留不同账户账本，并支持核对和校正记录。
昔涟余额挂件的功能「会话用量统计」：聚合 DSH 会话事件中的模型用量，提供每日及按模型查看的记录。
昔涟余额挂件的功能「开屏与问候」：聊天页可播放开屏视频及分时段语音问候，问候音频可从启用的语句中选择。
昔涟余额挂件的功能「角色和音效定制」：聊天挂件提供角色展示、音效组选择和导入入口，用户可在界面切换或管理素材。

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Cyrene Balance Widget 2.2.3 (Animated)：[](https://dsh.market/)
**New in 2.2.3** — the widget now ships its own font (a rounded handwritten face) and
can be switched between that and the system font from the settings panel. The opening
animation gained a mute switch for quiet launches. Balance figures are drawn in a pink
gradient instead of the old blue. Package size dropped from 30.8 MB to 17.6 MB, which
makes market installs far less likely to arrive incomplete.

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Cyrene Balance Widget 2.2.3 (Animated)：**New in 2.2.2** — the greeting picker now avoids repeating the line it played last time (remembered across restarts).

**New in 2.2.1** — the greeting voice can now be controlled line by line: the settings panel lists every line as text
with its own checkbox, so you can turn off any of them (or all of them). The old "帝皇权杖·铁墓" random line has been
replaced, and there are now four random greetings instead of three.

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Cyrene Balance Widget 2.2.3 (Animated)：**New in 2.2** — settings toggles for the splash animation and the greeting voice (state kept in `localStorage`),
an idle greeting (20 minutes without input → the widget says a line in a bubble), and the ledger button is now
labelled "Cyrene's ledger" instead of the whale one.

On client startup it plays a full-screen opening animation (`assets/loading.mp4`, 1440p / 60fps, ~20 MB, 13.9 s),
fades out into the UI, and 2.5 seconds later plays "Cyrene's Greeting".

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · What this build does：| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| Loading animation | Full-screen `loading.mp4` (2560×1440, H.264, 60fps, ~20 MB) with `object-fit: cover` |
| Audio | Original soundtrack kept at full volume; **linear fade-out over the last 2.2 s** — the sound lasts exactly as long as the animation |
| Exit | Overlay fades out over 900 ms, the page fades in naturally |
| Greeting | **2.5 s after** the fade-out completes, `assets/greeting.wav` (3.58 s) plays together with a short toast |
| Interaction | **No skip button, no fullscreen request, no hiding of window buttons** — just a plain opening animation |
| Fallbacks | Autoplay with sound blocked → retry muted; not playing within 2.6 s → skip; hard release at 20 s |

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · The widget itself：- Character: built-in Cyrene sprite (610×610, transparent, bottom-aligned)
- Lines: 25 quotes, font sizes 6/7/8/9, shown at random
- First click: balance panel; next click: a random quote
- Everything else (sound effects, snapping, accounting, bubble editor) comes from `dsh-whale-widget` 0.4.2

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Customising：- **Lines**: right-click the widget → bubble settings; or `BUBBLE_DEFAULT_ITEMS` in `assets/whale-widget.js`; batch via `tools/set-lines.py`
- **Font size**: `tools/resize-lines.py` (edit `SIZE_MAP`, then re-run)
- **Greeting audio**: replace `assets/greeting.wav`, refresh to apply
- **Opening animation**: replace `assets/loading.mp4` (H.264 recommended for widest compatibility)

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Install：`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`, with `target` set to this directory's absolute path.
The no-animation build lives in `../no-animation/` (package `dsh-cyrene-whale-widget-noanim`). Both share the
`/dsh-whale/*` routes and `$DSH_HOME/.dshw-*.json`, so only one can be enabled at a time.

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Installation troubleshooting：The DSH Market installs plugins by cloning the GitHub repository with `pnpm add git+...`.
On slow or unstable connections that clone can stop halfway, which leaves the widget
with missing assets — typically only one broken character image shows up.

If that happens, install manually instead:

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · Installation troubleshooting：1. Download `Cyrene-Balance-Widget-<version>-Animated.zip` from the
   [latest release](https://github.com/sailina-afk/cyrene-balance-widget/releases/latest)
2. Unzip it anywhere
3. In DSH: settings → plugins → install local plugin, pick the unzipped folder
4. Fully quit the client and start it again

The release zip is the same code, just packaged without git history. It downloads as a
single file, so it cannot arrive half-finished.

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 昔涟余额挂件 2.2（带动画）：[](https://dsh.market/)
**2.2.3 新增**——插件自带一套圆润手写字体，可在设置面板切换「奶酪体 / 系统字体」；开屏动画新增静音开关，夜里启动不吵人；余额数字改为粉色渐变；包体从 30.8 MB 降到 17.6 MB，市场安装更容易装全。

**2.2.2 新增**——问候语音不再连续重复：会记住上一次播的那条，下次从剩下的里抽。

**2.2.1 新增**——问候语音可以逐条开关了：设置面板把每一句的内容以文字列出来，各自一个勾选框，想听哪条勾哪条，
全取消则不播。原来的「帝皇权杖·铁墓」那句已删除并换成新的，随机问候从三条变成四条。

**2.2 新增**——设置面板里加了「开屏动画」「问候语音」两个开关（状态存在 `localStorage`）；
闲置 20 分钟无操作时，挂件会主动弹一次气泡说句话；记账按钮文案由「小鲸鱼记账」改为「昔涟记账」。

> 中文原文备份，英文版见 `README.md`。

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 昔涟余额挂件 2.2（带动画）：打开客户端先播一段全屏开场动画（`assets/loading.mp4`，1440p / 60fps，约 20 MB，13.9 秒），播完淡出进入界面，
再过 2.5 秒播放「昔涟的问候」。

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 这一版的样子：| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 加载动画 | 全屏播放 `loading.mp4`（2560×1440，H.264，60fps，约 20 MB），`object-fit: cover` 铺满 |
| 音效 | 保留原声，全程原音量；**最后 2.2 秒线性淡出**，动画多长声音就多长 |
| 结束 | 播完 overlay 900ms 淡出，页面自然渐显 |
| 问候 | 淡出完成 **2.5 秒**后播放 `assets/greeting.wav`（3.58 秒），同时轻提示一句 |
| 交互 | **没有跳过按钮、不请求全屏、不隐藏窗口按钮**——就是纯开场动画 |
| 兜底 | 带声播放被拦→静音重试；2.6 秒没起播（HEVC 解不了）→ 跳过；20 秒强制放行 |

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 挂件本体：- 形象：内置角色昔涟（610×610 透明底、底部对齐）
- 台词：25 句（`E:\昔涟.txt`），字号 6/7/8/9，随机出现
- 首次点击：余额面板；再点：随机台词
- 其余（音效、吸附、记账、泡泡编辑器）沿用 `dsh-whale-widget` 0.4.2

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 改东西：- **台词**：右键挂件 → 泡泡设置；或 `assets/whale-widget.js` 的 `BUBBLE_DEFAULT_ITEMS`；批量用 `tools/set-lines.py`
- **字号**：`tools/resize-lines.py`（改 `SIZE_MAP` 后重跑）
- **问候语音**：替换 `assets/greeting.wav`，刷新即生效
- **开场动画**：替换 `assets/loading.mp4`（建议 H.264，兼容性最好）

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 安装：`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`，`target` 用本目录绝对路径。
无动画版在 `../no-animation/`（包名 `dsh-cyrene-whale-widget-noanim`），两版共用
`/dsh-whale/*` 路由与 `$DSH_HOME/.dshw-*.json`，同一时间只能启用一个。

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 素材来源：形象：用户提供的昔涟表情图；台词：`E:\昔涟.txt`；问候：`E:\直播录像与素材\昔涟的问候.wav`；
开场动画：`E:\直播录像与素材\昔涟.mp4`；上游 `dsh-whale-widget` v0.4.2（MIT）。

dsh-cyrene-whale-widget README · 装不上怎么办：DSH 插件市场是通过克隆 GitHub 仓库来安装的（`pnpm add git+...`）。网络不稳时克隆可能中断，装出来的插件会缺文件——通常表现为小人图破掉、其他功能都没有。

遇到这种情况改成手动安装：

1. 从 [最新 Release](https://github.com/sailina-afk/cyrene-balance-widget/releases/latest) 下载 `Cyrene-Balance-Widget-<version>-Animated.zip`
2. 解压到任意目录
3. DSH 里：设置 → 插件 → 安装本地插件，选中解压后的目录
4. 完全退出客户端再启动

Release 的 zip 是同一份代码，只是不带 git 历史。它是单文件下载，不会出现装一半的情况。
